8209.title: Host section label duplicates a plugin panel heading
8209.rootCauseOneLine: Shared section chrome adds the panel title for every non-null back route, including plugin-owned sidebars.

prReviews.verdict: Static-only: addresses the observed mechanism; branch not executed

8209.proposedFix: Suppress only plugin section labels while retaining a named semantic sidebar and core section defaults; update the documented host presentation contract.
8209.caveats: Hook behavior reproduced in two clean trusted checkouts. Current built-in Tasks uses a right-panel tab instead; Source Control and mobile examples not verified. Existing SDK documentation describes the title addition. No new PR because open PR #8210 closes the issue.
